name: Mohave yucca
desc: Mohave yucca (Yucca schidigera): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 148 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Yucca schidigera, also known as the Mojave yucca or Spanish dagger, is a perennial plant in the asparagus family Asparagaceae, native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico.
